Author: TwinkiToes
Name: Chat Colors
Description: Adds local-only color tags for ChatTwo messages using FFXIV UIColor rows <0> to <77> and <500> to <521>, plus <reset>.
Punchline: Local display colors for ChatTwo messages.
Changelog: 0.1.1.0: Reduced framework work by scanning only after tagged Echo messages, checks only the newest visible ChatTwo messages, and logs the version on load.
